diagnosis: The query handler replays vehicle telemetry events from EventStoreDB for any requested vin without verifying that the vehicle belongs to the authenticated operator's fleet organization. An operator can track location coordinates and speeds of vehicles belonging to competing fleets.
exploit_request:
GET /api/queries/telemetry/1HGCR2F83HA001928 HTTP/1.1
Host: fleet-cqrs.telematics.io
Authorization: Bearer <fleet_operator_token>
